message.content: A large, pale blue gloved hand holds a rectangular device slanted downwards towards the right. The device is white plastic with bright magenta accents and a small rectangular window containing three pink vertical lines. Small human figures, painted in a textured style, interact with the device. Some figures walk across its top surface from left to right. At the device’s right edge, three figures are depicted mid-fall in various orientations. More small figures walk in the background against a teal gradient. A large, semi-transparent grey word "TEMPO" appears behind the hand. To the left is a solid red vertical stripe. Large black text reads "TEPERDAYA TES CORONA." Below this, smaller text reads "RATUSAN RIBU ALAT UJI CEPAT COVID-19 YANG DIRAGUKAN AKURASINYA BEREDAR DI INDONESIA. HASIL INVESTIGASI TEMPO DALAM KOLABORASI ORGANIZED CRIME AND CORRUPTION REPORTING PROJECT (OCCRP)." Additional text at the top includes "MACAN KERTAS ATURAN SAWIT" and "AKSI POLISI JERAT JURNALIS." At the bottom, there is a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "11-17 MEI 2020," "RP 45.000," and "ISSN: 0126-4273."
